message: fix(onboarding): fit the existing objective card to short and scaled Windows viewports
purpose: Keep the existing HUD framework while moving the same objective card below the minimap on short viewports. Retain one objective, its real contextual action, persistent hints and optional social access; move secondary notices only into available space. Verify rectangle containment and non-overlap across minimum, HD and high-DPI/text-scale cases.
